name: Aanjaay Industries Limited
about: Aanjaay Industries Limited engages in the manufacture and trade of pharmaceutical products. Its product portfolio includes cardiovascular, anti-infective, oncology, gastroenterologic, hormonal, and miscellaneous drugs; critical care injectibles, pre-filled syringes, and active pharmaceutical ingredients. The company was formerly known as Kabra Drugs Limited and changed its name to Aanjaay Industries Limited in July 2026. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Chennai, India.
